_about: Henry Fynes Clinton (1781-1852), chronologer, raw IA OCR of Fasti Hellenici (3 vols, 1824-1834) and Fasti Romani (2 vols, 1845-1850). Dense with Greek and Latin quotation; kept under Adam's 2026-10-23 Greek ruling. A Burt Franklin reprint of Fasti Hellenici vol. I was passed over for the 1834 printing. Greek history (lane B, round eb: eighth IA subject sweep). No uids minted.
